Package com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.out.persistence

Class KfeLightningLiquidityService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.out.persistence.KfeLightningLiquidityService
All Implemented Interfaces:
LiquidityReservationUseCase
@Service public class KfeLightningLiquidityService extends Object implements LiquidityReservationUseCase
Outbound Lightning liquidity: capacity probe + reservation until HTLC terminal state. Pooled node model — free capacity = local balance − sum(HELD reservations).

    • circuitBreakerOpen

      public boolean circuitBreakerOpen()
      Circuit breaker with hysteresis and sustained-stress awareness.

      Trips when free (post-reservation) outbound capacity drops below the floor OR sustained liquidity-reject count exceeds the stress threshold. Once tripped, stays open until free capacity recovers above the recovery threshold (1.2× floor).
